title: BTSCon 2026 Presentations: Welcome, Tools for Big Team Science, and Zenodo Tutorial
description: Slides and materials from the 5th annual Big Team Science Conference (BTSCon 2026): the welcome session, two talks on tools for big team science from the CONNECT Tools and Infrastructure Working Group, and a tutorial on archiving work with Zenodo and GitHub releases.
